answer: Streak multipliers at the ferrous ledger: each identity starts at 1.0x, +0.1x per consecutive epoch, capped 3.0x. A sybil splitting into 20 fresh identities earns 1.0x each while an honest node compounds past 2.5x. The reef of verified history makes resetting costly: abandoning a 30-epoch streak forfeits 2.0x reputation worth ~40% of rewards. The mesa of capped returns means farming never outpaces a single long-lived node. Cost: 20 identities yield less than one veteran, so sybil economics fail.
